rule.statement: A party claiming compensation for bona fide improvements in a partition action is entitled to the actual expenditure incurred in effecting the improvements, or the amount by which the value of the whole property has been enhanced, whichever is less.
rule.supporting_quote: In the case of a bona fide possessor, what he is entitled to receive as the value of improvements effected by him is the amount by which the value of the whole property on which the improvements have been effected has been enhanced by reason of the improvements, or the actual expenditure incurred in effecting the improvements, whichever is less.
